archetype: Hybrid of 4 (Swiss/High-Contrast) and 7 (Electric & Neon - Red/Black Tactical)

color_system.background: Deep Void Black (#050505) and Aegis Dark Grey (#121212)
color_system.notes: Strict red-black-white palette. No teal, no purple. Black must be absolute or tinted slightly red.

typography.headings: Rajdhani, Teko, or similar angular/military sans (uppercase, bold). NEVER use Inter.
typography.body: Share Tech Mono, JetBrains Mono, or IBM Plex Mono. Prioritize monospace for data readability.
typography.terminal: VT323 or pure monospace for the ASCII banner, raw logs, and boot sequences.

layout_spacing.grid_system: The Control Room Grid (tight gaps gap-4, full-height panels, dense information density).
layout_spacing.padding: Generous inside large cinematic panels (p-8), tight inside tactical data widgets (p-4).
layout_spacing.borders: Use chamfered/cut corners via CSS clip-path: polygon(10px 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 10px), calc(100% - 10px) 100%, 0 100%, 0 10px). Do not use rounded-xl.

surface_strategies.cards: Grid Borders ('Technical' Look). Sharp edges, zero border-radius. 1px solid red/20 or red/40 borders.
surface_strategies.panels: Terminal aesthetics. Deep black background, bright red borders, faint scanline overlay.
surface_strategies.hud_elements: Data blocks separated by thick red lines. Sticky left navigation, dynamic right widgets (Aegis Advanced UI pattern).

motion_interactions.hover: Tactical instant swap (text-black bg-red-600) or subtle text glitch effect.
motion_interactions.entrance: Staggered 'boot up' sequence mimicking ship systems powering up. Fast typing effect for terminal headers.
motion_interactions.alerts: Pulsing red opacity for warnings, 'CLASSIFIED' stamps, or low-fuel indicators.

media.description: Abstract red neon/cubic background. Overlay heavily with black and scanlines to act as a HUD projection.
Dark tactical soldier. Use for the 'Ironclad Griffin' or 'Presidential Guard' section. Apply grayscale + red tint filter.
Aerial fleet visualization. Use for 'SATO Navy' section. Desaturate and tint red to fit the military HUD aesthetic.

lore_and_content.tagline: A nomadic, sovereign military force maintaining its own laws, borders, and lethal authority beyond UEE reach.

departments.name: Presidential Guard
departments.desc: Elite protection for the High Council. Authorized for absolute enforcement within SATO territory and high-value VIP escort.

departments.name: Military Police
departments.desc: Ensuring operational discipline and internal law. Tasked with prisoner transport, border security, and protocol enforcement.

departments.name: Intel & Recon
departments.desc: Deep-space reconnaissance and information gathering. The eyes and ears of the fleet, scouting the Iron Corridor.

departments.name: Fleet Operations
departments.desc: Commanding the Void Sentinels and Capital assets. Specialized in heavy naval dominance and strategic defense.

departments.name: Marine Corps
departments.desc: Planetary assault and ship boarding specialists. The 'Griffin Strike' units represent our primary shock force.

departments.name: Science Division
departments.desc: Developing 'Ghost Wire' stealth protocols and industrial optimization. The intelligence engine of the state.

departments.name: Industrial Power
departments.desc: The economic backbone. Fueling, mining, and salvage operations that sustain our military reach.

specific_instructions_for_main_agent: You are building an immersive diegetic UI. Do NOT build a generic SaaS dashboard. It must feel like an in-game Star Citizen terminal (Aegis manufacturer style).
Use Phosphor icons (bold/duotone) for militaristic symbols.
Include an explicit 'Declare Allegiance' CTA that triggers a Discord OAuth login flow (mock or real depending on backend setup). HUD should show role-based access status post-login.

Architecture Mapping: The user requested specific HTML files (index.html, government.html, etc.). If using React, map these to React Router paths (/, /government, /departments, /operations, /personnel, /codex, /judiciary, /archives). If doing pure HTML/Tailwind, strictly follow the requested file structure.
For the chamfered corners, use CSS clip-path. Avoid generic Shadcn rounded cards. If you use Shadcn components, completely override their borders to be sharp (rounded-none) and border-red-600/50.
Implement a CSS CRT scanline effect over the entire application wrapper (pointer-events-none, repeating-linear-gradient).
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, navigation links, and interactive elements.
